changed.title: The 8 by 8 graph with mask 10691974706225816370 is represented on the one-a-side promise by an AND/OR circuit of fan-in two with at most 24 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 8 => (10691974706225816370 : ℕ).testBit (8 * u.val + v.val)) 24
changed.unlocks: the least cost of one dense 8 by 8 graph with no equal lines, approached from above
changed.sketch: We hold no circuit of this size; this is a search. Our circuit is the row star with shared ORs; pairs of columns that occur together in several rows may save gates.

changed.title: With one row and one column on, two ORs pairing four once-read inputs force equal crossed entries for gates of any kind reading earlier wires
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool)
  (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
  (u u' : Fin n) (b b' : Fin m),
  let x := u.val
  let x' := u'.val
  let y := n + b.val
  let y' := n + b'.val
  let paired := fun (r c : ℕ) =>
    ∃ g ∈ C.gates, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧
      (g.inputs = [r, c] ∨ g.inputs = [c, r])
  u ≠ u' → b ≠ b' →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C →
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C →
  paired x y → paired x' y' →
  (∀ w ∈ [x, x', y, y'],
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.readsIn C (Finset.range C.size) w = 1) →
  C.output ∉ [x, x', y, y'] →
  G u b' = G u' b
changed.unlocks: a tool for counting how often a line is read on the one-a-side promise, for the line of what a second read of a row costs; it moves no bound by itself
changed.context: On paper. Compare the two inputs (u, b') and (u', b). On both, the OR reading row u with column b and the OR reading row u' with column b' are true. Each of the four special input wires is read at one operand position only, the one in its OR, so no other gate reads any of them. Induct along the gate list: away from the four wires the two inputs give equal wire values; at the two ORs both values are true; at any other gate the operand values are equal, so its value is equal. The output wire is none of the four inputs, so the outputs agree. Represents turns them into G(u, b') and G(u', b).

changed.title: The two-lit function of the graph H on 6 points with mask 274910127 on shared wires has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 6 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 6 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 6, C.eval (List.ofFn fun k : Fin 6 => decide (k = i ∨ k = j)) = (274910127 : ℕ).testBit (6 * min i.val j.val + max i.val j.val)
changed.unlocks: the exact size of the two-lit-points function of this graph on six shared wires; the family shows where a NOT gate pays with no equal lines
changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 7 gates, a weak hand form (best over a few point orders and the complement plus a NOT, equal gates merged): OR(0,1), OR(2,6), NOT(7), AND(5,8), AND(4,7), OR(9,10), NOT(11) (inputs 0-5 are the points, gate k is wire 6 + k, output last). We hold no circuit of 6 gates; this is a search. No complete search of ours has run at six points.
